title: The Unfinished Species — Between Births
description:
THE UNFINISHED SPECIES — Between Births

An exploration of humanity as an unfinished journey. Moving through cycles of birth, death, suffering, resistance and renewal, we remain in a constant state of becoming. The cocoon becomes a world within itself — a womb, a refuge and a space of transformation. Rooted in the contradictions of our collective existence, the work questions whether humanity has truly evolved, or is still travelling towards its next beginning.

Perhaps we are not yet born…we are simply between births.

title: Kundalini — The Cosmic Chakra
description: An exploration of human nature as a reflection of the cosmos. Inspired by Kundalini and chakra philosophy, this artwork brings together serpents, human forms and elemental forces to explore the relationship between instinct, consciousness and universal energy. It reflects my fascination with the unseen forces that connect all existence, where the primal and the spiritual coexist, and the human being becomes a universe within itself.
